# Turfy

> Free football match live scoring, tournament management, and player stats tracker. 100% free forever, no ads, works offline.

- Website: https://playturfy.com/
- Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.turfy.matchscorer
- Platform: Android (Android 5.0+) — iOS version in active development
- Pricing: Free forever, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases, zero ads

## Core Features
- **Live Match Scoring**: Record goals, assists, yellow/red cards, substitutions, and penalties with live timers.
- **Tournament Management**: Automatic fixture generation and real-time standings for Round Robin, Knockouts, and Group Stages.
- **Player & Team Statistics**: Automatic career and tournament tracking for top scorers, assists, cards, and clean sheets.
- **Offline First**: Full offline functionality for pitches with weak or no mobile signal; automatic cloud sync when reconnected.
- **Live Broadcasting Overlay**: Transparent browser overlay URL for OBS Studio, vMix, and live streaming software.
- **Instant Match Reports**: One-tap export to clean PDF match sheets and social media graphic cards.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Is Turfy free?** Yes, 100% free forever with no paywalls or advertising.
- **Does it work without internet?** Yes, match scoring and tournament brackets work completely offline.
- **Who is it for?** Grassroots football teams, academy coaches, community leagues, street football organizers, and recreational players.
